message.content:
Based on my search, Jay Ellis's height is reported slightly differently across sources, but he is generally listed between **6 feet 2 inches and 6 feet 3½ inches** tall:

- **6 feet 3½ inches (191.8 cm)** according to Celeb Heights (as reported by one source)
- **6 feet 2½ inches (189 cm)** according to Who's Dated Who
- **6 feet 2 inches** according to MrDustbin
- **"Almost 6-feet, 3-inches"** according to BET

The most commonly cited figure appears to be around **6 feet 2½ inches to 6 feet 3 inches**, with Celeb Heights providing the most specific measurement at 6'3½".

Sources:
1. https://sfp.mlga.ek.gov.ng/how-tall-is-the-insecure-actor-and-5-facts-about-him.html
2. https://www.whosdatedwho.com/dating/jay-ellis
3. https://www.bet.com/photo-gallery/xy9a84/jay-ellis-is-in-the-game/gej1ge
4. https://www.mrdustbin.com/us/jay-ellis/
